entries.053c13a9df73b0ac: This category provides maintenance and upkeep of information systems. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,014 million.
entries.081ca4ea55beedbe: Private-sector customers such as private companies
entries.88f0d37dbc530c01: This category provides other system-related services. It includes BPO services and outsourcing at group companies. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,571 million.
entries.8b459847a44f6c52: This category operates information systems after they go live. It performs operational processing for the public sector and operations under quasi-mandate contracts and similar arrangements in the private sector. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥12,685 million.
entries.a94de6a0cdee9063: A company that provides local governments and private companies with consistent services from planning and development to operation and maintenance of information systems.
entries.b79cf74369bf1c47: It is an information services company headquartered in Chuo-ku, Tokyo, and forms a group with four consolidated subsidiaries. It provides integrated services ranging from planning and development of information systems and networks to operation, maintenance and upkeep after launch, and its business fields form a single segment, the Information Services Business. Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥36,616 million, and consolidated employees numbered 1,204.
entries.c753a345694237aa: Public-sector customers such as local governments
entries.d22bfe3884637cd1: This category develops information systems and software. Starting with the administrative system for local governments “WebRings,” it carries out contract-based software development and other work for public-sector and private-sector customers. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥16,672 million.
entries.e2219d832651a3e8: This category sells information equipment and software. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥672 million.
